+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_authentication_failure_raises(
+        self,
+        fmc_client: FMCClient,
+        httpx_mock: HTTPXMock,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test authentication failure closes with a clear runtime error."""
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="POST",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/auth/generatetoken",
+            status_code=401,
+            text="unauthorized",
+        )
+
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="FMC authentication failed"):
+            await fmc_client.connect()
+        await fmc_client.close()
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_authentication_discovers_domain_uuid(
+        self,
+        httpx_mock: HTTPXMock,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test auth stores the response domain UUID when settings omit it."""
+        settings = FMCSettings(
+            fmc_host="fmc.test.local",
+            fmc_username="test",
+            fmc_password="test",  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        )
+        client = FMCClient(settings)
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="POST",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/auth/generatetoken",
+            status_code=204,
+            headers={
+                "X-auth-access-token": "token",
+                "X-auth-refresh-token": "refresh",
+                "DOMAIN_UUID": "discovered-domain",
+            },
+        )
+
+        await client.connect()
+        assert client.domain_uuid == "discovered-domain"
+        await client.close()
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_refresh_token_without_client_returns_false(
+        self,
+        fmc_client: FMCClient,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test refresh is skipped before the client is connected."""
+        assert await fmc_client._refresh_auth_token() is False
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_refresh_limit_triggers_reauthentication(
+        self,
+        fmc_client: FMCClient,
+        httpx_mock: HTTPXMock,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test FMC's refresh limit falls back to full authentication."""
+        for token in ("initial", "reauth"):
+            httpx_mock.add_response(
+                method="POST",
+                url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/auth/generatetoken",
+                status_code=204,
+                headers={
+                    "X-auth-access-token": token,
+                    "X-auth-refresh-token": f"{token}-refresh",
+                },
+            )
+
+        await fmc_client.connect()
+        fmc_client._refresh_count = fmc_client._max_refreshes
+        assert await fmc_client._refresh_auth_token() is True
+        assert fmc_client._access_token == "reauth"
+        assert fmc_client._refresh_count == 0
+        await fmc_client.close()
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_refresh_failure_reauthenticates(
+        self,
+        fmc_client: FMCClient,
+        httpx_mock: HTTPXMock,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test failed refresh response falls back to full authentication."""
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="POST",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/auth/generatetoken",
+            status_code=204,
+            headers={"X-auth-access-token": "initial", "X-auth-refresh-token": "refresh"},
+        )
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="POST",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/auth/refreshtoken",
+            status_code=500,
+        )
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="POST",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/auth/generatetoken",
+            status_code=204,
+            headers={"X-auth-access-token": "reauth", "X-auth-refresh-token": "reauth-refresh"},
+        )
+
+        await fmc_client.connect()
+        assert await fmc_client._refresh_auth_token() is True
+        assert fmc_client._access_token == "reauth"
+        await fmc_client.close()
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_get_domain_info(
+        self,
+        fmc_client: FMCClient,
+        mock_auth_response: None,
+        httpx_mock: HTTPXMock,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test domain info convenience request."""
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="GET",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/info/domain",
+            json={"name": "Global"},
+        )
+
+        async with fmc_client:
+            assert await fmc_client.get_domain_info() == {"name": "Global"}
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_rate_limit_retry_after_zero(
+        self,
+        fmc_client: FMCClient,
+        mock_auth_response: None,
+        httpx_mock: HTTPXMock,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test 429 responses are retried after the requested delay."""
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="GET",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/info/serverversion",
+            status_code=429,
+            headers={"Retry-After": "0"},
+        )
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="GET",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/fmc_platform/v1/info/serverversion",
+            json={"serverVersion": "7.4.2.3"},
+        )
+
+        async with fmc_client:
+            version = await fmc_client.get_server_version()
+            assert version["serverVersion"] == "7.4.2.3"
+
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_get_all_items_fetches_multiple_pages(
+        self,
+        fmc_client: FMCClient,
+        mock_auth_response: None,
+        httpx_mock: HTTPXMock,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Test pagination continues until the reported total is fetched."""
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="GET",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/items?limit=1000&offset=0&expanded=true",
+            json={"items": [{"id": "one"}], "paging": {"count": 1001}},
+        )
+        httpx_mock.add_response(
+            method="GET",
+            url="https://fmc.test.local/api/items?limit=1000&offset=1000&expanded=true",
+            json={"items": [{"id": "two"}], "paging": {"count": 1001}},
+        )
+
+        async with fmc_client:
+            assert await fmc_client.get_all_items("/api/items") == [{"id": "one"}, {"id": "two"}]

index 0000000..b8ae55e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_server.py
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+"""Tests for the FastMCP server wiring."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from fmc_mcp import server
+
+
+class FakeFMCClient:
+    def __init__(self, settings: object) -> None:
+        self.settings = settings
+        self.connected = False
+        self.closed = False
+
+    async def connect(self) -> None:
+        self.connected = True
+
+    async def close(self) -> None:
+        self.closed = True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_lifespan_connects_and_clears_client(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    """Test lifespan initializes the FMC client and clears it on shutdown."""
+    fake_settings = object()
+    clients: list[FakeFMCClient] = []
+    resource_clients: list[FakeFMCClient] = []
+
+    def make_client(settings: object) -> FakeFMCClient:
+        client = FakeFMCClient(settings)
+        clients.append(client)
+        return client
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "get_settings", lambda: fake_settings)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "FMCClient", make_client)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server.resources, "set_client", resource_clients.append)
+
+    async with server.lifespan(server.mcp):
+        assert server._client is clients[0]
+        assert clients[0].connected is True
+        assert resource_clients == [clients[0]]
+
+    assert clients[0].closed is True
+    assert server._client is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_lifespan_closes_even_when_context_raises(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    """Test lifespan cleanup runs when the managed context raises."""
+    fake_settings = object()
+    client = FakeFMCClient(fake_settings)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "get_settings", lambda: fake_settings)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "FMCClient", lambda settings: client)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server.resources, "set_client", lambda value: None)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
+        async with server.lifespan(server.mcp):
+            raise RuntimeError("boom")
+
+    assert client.closed is True
+    assert server._client is None
+
+
+def test_main_http_mode_handles_invalid_port(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    """Test HTTP mode falls back to the default port and runs SSE."""
+    calls: list[str] = []
+
+    class FakeMCP:
+        async def run_sse_async(self) -> None:
+            calls.append("sse")
+
+        def run(self) -> None:
+            calls.append("stdio")
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCP_TRANSPORT", "http")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCP_PORT", "not-a-port")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "mcp", FakeMCP())
+
+    server.main()
+
+    assert calls == ["sse"]
+
+
+def test_main_defaults_to_stdio(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    """Test stdio mode delegates to FastMCP.run."""
+    calls: list[str] = []
+
+    class FakeMCP:
+        async def run_sse_async(self) -> None:
+            calls.append("sse")
+
+        def run(self) -> None:
+            calls.append("stdio")
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MCP_TRANSPORT", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "mcp", FakeMCP())
+
+    server.main()
+
+    assert calls == ["stdio"]
